headline: Iran Says the Strait of Hormuz Will Stay Closed. What Happens to the US Economy Next?
summary: Iran says the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed. Economists differ on how fuel shortages from the oil supply shock may affect US growth and inflation.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key route for global oil and LNG shipments, so closures affect energy prices, inflation and growth worldwide.
why_moved: A continued closure of the Strait of Hormuz threatens a large share of seaborne oil flows, which directly raises the risk of supply shortages and higher crude prices.
